tools.description: Call this FIRST; returns the latest usage guide for shopping with `buy` AND for operating the Agentcard account tools (cards, funding, your own card, KYC, support).

tools.name: whoami

tools.name: get_card_details

tools.name: get_card_balance
tools.description: The live balance of ONE virtual card (the user's overall cash balance is get_balance). Prefer this over get_card_details when you only need to verify available funds: it is faster and does not expose sensitive card credentials.

tools.name: close_card
tools.description: Permanently close a virtual card. This is irreversible — the card cannot be reopened. Safe to call on an already-closed card (idempotent). tools.name: get_card_preset
tools.description: Read a card's preset (spend limits, rate limits, allowed categories/merchants, time windows, and surfaces) as a plain-English summary. A card without a preset is unrestricted.

tools.name: set_card_preset
tools.description: Update a card's preset. Pass a template name (ai_labs, weekday_meals, cli_only, daily), a saved preset name (from list_presets), a comma-separated template list, or inline JSON / { name, privileges }. Pass null or "" to clear the card's preset (Agentcard-side checks stop; any limit already on the ca

tools.name: allow_card_merchant
tools.description: Remember a merchant on a card so the next matching charge is allowed even when the card's category or merchant rules would otherwise deny it. One tool call — does not replace the rest of the preset.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List every preset you can use by name: the built-in templates (ai_labs, weekday_meals, cli_only, daily) plus any you've saved yourself, each with a plain-English summary of its rules.

tools.name: save_preset
tools.description: Save your own preset — a named set of rules (spend caps, category/merchant/place/currency/day/hour/program restrictions) you can reuse by name in set_card_preset or create_card. Saving under a name you already used adds a new version: cards already using the old one keep it, new ones get the update.

tools.name: delete_preset
tools.description: Delete a preset you saved (from save_preset). Refuses built-in template names — there's nothing to delete there. Cards already issued keep whatever rules they have; this only retires the name for future use. Refused while a card still inherits the name as a standing default.

tools.name: get_wallet_link
tools.description: The user's hosted wallet, as one shareable URL. tools.name: list_added_cards
tools.description: List the user's ADDED cards (their own Visa/Mastercard cards enrolled via create_card's add-card flow — the funding source that charges their own card), with ids, brand, last4, expiry, and status. tools.name: remove_added_card
tools.description: Remove (unenroll) one of the user's added cards. Irreversible for that enrollment: any virtual cards created against it are closed first, then the card is unenrolled at the network. ALWAYS confirm with the user before calling. Get ids from list_added_cards. The user can add the same card again later

tools.name: pause_card
tools.description: Pause a multi-use card: temporarily blocks ALL new charges (reversible — use resume_card to unblock). Right for "stop this subscription for now" or a card the user suspects is compromised but is not sure. Only multi-use cards can be paused; single-use cards close after one charge and cannot be pause

tools.name: resume_card
tools.description: Resume a paused multi-use card so it accepts charges again. The inverse of pause_card.

tools.name: update_card_limit
tools.description: Change a multi-use card's total spending limit. Raising it reserves the extra amount from the user's cash balance (top up with add_funds if short); lowering it frees the difference, but the new limit can never go below what the card has already spent. Single-use cards cannot be resized.

tools.name: get_rewards
tools.description: Show the user's tokenback: balance, lifetime earned, and recent activity. Tokenback pays tokens (1 token = 1¢ of credit value) on settled card spend. tools.name: redeem_rewards

tools.name: recommend_card
tools.description: Ask the vault which of the user's own stored cards earns the most for a purchase (smart purchases). Pass the merchant name, its website when you know it, and the amount. Returns the card id to use as card_id at checkout, the reason in plain words, and the runners-up. null when smart purchases is off

tools.name: name_card

tools.name: buy_unlink_merchant

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: buy, whoami, create_card, get_wallet_link, list_added_cards, read_support_chat, list_pending_approvals, submit_kyc_document, setup_payment_method, upgrade_plan, get_settings · Private data: list_cards, get_card_details, get_card_balance, close_card, create_card, get_wallet_link, get_rewards, redeem_rewards, recommend_card, name_card, approve_request, start_kyc, submit_kyc_document, check_kyc_document, submit_kyc_fields, get_balance, add_funds, revoke_connection, get_settings, manage_subscription · Public sink: whoami, create_card, get_wallet_link, get_rewards, start_support_chat, send_support_message, submit_user_info, start_kyc, submit_kyc_document, check_kyc_document, submit_kyc_fields, start_phone_verification, get_settings, link_account · Destructive: buy, delete_preset, remove_added_card.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: buy, whoami, create_card, get_wallet_link, list_added_cards, read_support_chat, list_pending_approvals, submit_kyc_document, setup_payment_method, upgrade_plan, get_settings · Private data: list_cards, get_card_details, get_card_balance, close_card, create_card, get_wallet_link, get_rewards, redeem_rewards, recommend_card, name_card, approve_request, start_kyc, submit_kyc_document, check_kyc_document, submit_kyc_fields, get_balance, add_funds, revoke_connection, get_settings, manage_subscription · Public sink: whoami, create_card, get_wallet_link, get_rewards, start_support_chat, send_support_message, submit_user_info, start_kyc, submit_kyc_document, check_kyc_document, submit_kyc_fields, start_phone_verification, get_settings, link_account · Destructive: buy, delete_preset, remove_added_card

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
